about_the_game:
Dive into a wild adventure where match-3 strategy meets furious tower defense!

Story:

You, a General known for your outstanding... skills, are interrupted mid-romantic evening with an elf. Suddenly, a desperate catgirl mage teleports into your bedroom, begging for help! Her world, Meowgia, is being plunged into chaos by a gruesome undead invasion, and only a legendary General can save them!

Prepare to forget your peaceful life, because now you must lead the defense of Meowgia, liberating the lands from corruption, charming (and more) the local ladies, and ultimately battling the powerful demoness behind the invasion!

Gameplay:

• Match-3: Resource Frenzy! Gather resources by connecting elements on the match-3 field! Your swaps are limited, so plan wisely. New moves are granted for defeating enemies and with the passage of time!

• Tower Defense: Build and Conquer! Use the resources you've gathered to construct towers, strategically placing them to stop the waves of approaching undead.

• Fusion: Power in Unity! Merge identical towers into more powerful ones using match-3 mechanics directly on the battlefield! Upgrade your defense in the blink of an eye!

• Progression: The General's Arsenal! For completing levels, you'll earn rewards: new towers, upgrades to existing ones, bonuses to resources, and extra moves. Create an unstoppable army!

• Lustful Adventures: Can't Live Without 'Em! Free the maidens of Meowgia and win their hearts (and more) in explicit scenes that reveal the world's history and provide valuable bonuses.

Features:

• Three unique stages with 10 levels each, featuring increasing difficulty and new challenges.

• Epic boss battles at the end of each stage, requiring strategic thinking and optimal deployment of forces.

• 12 explicit scenes with hot girls, revealing the plot and motivating you to victory!

• Humorous dialogues between levels, offering tips, revealing lore, and simply raising your spirits.

• Numerous upgrades and towers allowing you to create unique strategies.

Get ready for an explosive mix of strategy, puzzles, and... spicy adventures! Meowgia awaits its hero!
